period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), Solo/Standalone basis -- matching the basis of this bank's existing Q4/annual series (see bank_financials/UTTARABANK/quarterly/2025_Q4.json). This source filing's package presents a full Consolidated statement FIRST, followed by a full Solo (non-consolidated) statement for the same date; the Solo figures were used throughout, per this dataset's standing 'prefer Solo over Consolidated' rule -- the Consolidated section was read and confirmed present but not used. Income-statement items are for the period 1 January to 31 March 2020 -- for Q1 this is simultaneously the cumulative-from-Jan-1 figure and the discrete-quarter figure (they are the same period), so no _cumulative/discrete distinction applies, though the _cumulative suffix is kept for naming consistency with the Q2/Q3 files in this series. reserve_fund is calculated as Statutory reserve plus Other reserves (same convention as the Q4 schema); non_funded_income_cumulative is calculated as Commission/Exchange/Brokerage plus Other Operating Income (matching CITYBANK's combined field, for cross-bank comparability) -- both granular components are also reported individually. tax_provision_cumulative is calculated as Current tax plus Deferred tax (the filing's own 'Provision for Taxation' subtotal line was not used directly in every year, since in at least one year that line carries a stray note-reference token in place of a value; the two components beneath it are unambiguous). Validated: Total Assets = Total Liabilities + Total Equity exactly; Net Interest Income = Interest Income - Interest Paid exactly; Total Operating Income = NII + Investment Income + Commission/Exchange/Brokerage + Other Operating Income exactly; Operating Profit = Total Operating Income - Total Operating Expenses exactly; Profit before Tax = Operating Profit - Provision exactly; Profit after Tax = Profit before Tax - Tax Provision exactly.
